name: Hermes
summary: Nous Research 的开源 agent：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行、或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Nous Research's open-source agent: view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when it runs in tmux or in the background through Kiteline

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 Hermes 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）
从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看
回复和确认需要 Hermes 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）

limitsNote: Hermes 使用你自己配置的模型服务（Nous Portal、OpenRouter 等），额度和余额请在对应服务的控制台查看，「今日用量」中不显示；token 和花费按 Hermes 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Hermes uses the model provider you configure (Nous Portal, OpenRouter and others), so check quota and balance in that provider's console; they aren't shown under Today's usage. Tokens and spend are counted from Hermes's own records
speaker: Hermes
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: Windows 上的查看还没实测（找进程的办法换成了 Windows 也能用的）
gaps.textEn: Viewing on Windows isn't tested yet (process detection now works on Windows too)

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)
